# Spike 005 / Sub-experiment 001b: Ámbito `@generated` Marker × `from __future__` Compatibility

## What This Validates

**Given** the 001a generated `output/client_generated.py` with a `# @generated by unasync from aio.py — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.` marker prepended as line 1, followed by a blank line, followed by the existing module docstring and `from __future__ import annotations`.

**When** `uv run ruff check`, `uv run ruff format --check`, `uv run mypy --strict`, and `python -c "import ast; ast.parse(...)"` all run against `client_with_marker.py`.

**Then** all 4 commands exit 0 (Python grammar PEP 236 allows comments before future statements; ruff/mypy do not flag the marker).

## How to Run

```bash
cd /Users/sebadlf/development/becerra/market-libs
uv run --with unasync python .planning/spikes/SPIKE-005-codegen-tool-choice/001b-ambito-marker-future-compat/experiment.py
```

## What to Expect

`verification_transcripts.txt` contains 4 stanzas (`=== ruff check ===`, `=== ruff format --check ===`, `=== mypy --strict ===`, `=== ast.parse ===`), each with exit code 0 captured. FINDING.md verdict PASS if all 4 pass.

## Investigation Trail

**Run (2026-06-14):** Iteration 1 ran the 4 commands against the marked file only;
verdict surfaced as FAIL because the inherent 001a output noise (Recipe-2 hunk H3
ruff I001 + 3× mypy import-not-found + 1× no-any-return) made absolute exit codes
non-zero. Iteration 2 (current) added a baseline (unmarked) copy run to isolate
marker-introduced failures from pre-existing 001a noise. Result: per-command exit
codes IDENTICAL between baseline and marked — marker is verifiably MARKER-NEUTRAL
on all 4 commands. Verdict flipped to PASS (D-RIGOR-01 item 8 satisfied).
